name: Self Service App
summary: Installs the Self Service app on every Mac and sets how it opens, notifies and asks users to log in.

settings.title: Install Self Service automatically
settings.description: Installs the Self Service app in /Applications on every managed Mac.

settings.title: Opens on
settings.description: The page users see when Self Service opens.

settings.title: Show notifications
settings.description: Notifies users about new items available in Self Service.

settings.title: User login
settings.description: Whether users log in to Self Service. Optional and Required show items scoped to the user.

settings.title: Authentication
settings.description: How users log in when login is optional or required. Single Sign-On needs Self Service SSO enabled in Jamf Pro's Single Sign-On settings.
